# FluentUI icon index

Generated by `scripts/build_icon_index.sh`. Do not edit by hand — edit
`scripts/fixtures/icon-index-tags-fluentui.tsv` and regenerate.

Each row points at a usable PNG path. The FluentUI System Icons set
ships a curated subset of 25 architecture-diagram concepts at sizes
24px / 32px / 48px in the `_color` (filled-color) variant. Scope is
defined by `scripts/fixtures/fluentui-curation.txt`.

Find an icon by name, size, or tag:

```bash
grep -i 'cloud' dist/FluentUI/INDEX.md         # by name
grep -F '`security`' dist/FluentUI/INDEX.md    # by tag
grep -F '| 48 |' dist/FluentUI/INDEX.md        # by size
```
